(Belyi Maps Noncritical at Prescribed Points) Let X be a smooth, proper, connected curve over \overline{\mathbb{Q}} and S,T \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) finite sets of \overline{\mathbb{Q}}-rational points such that S \cap T = \emptyset. Then there exists a morphism \phi : X \to \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} such that: (a) \phi is unramified over \mathbb{P}^{1}_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}\backslash\{0,1,\infty\}; (b) \phi(S) \subseteq \{0,1,\infty\}; (c) we have \phi(T) \cap \{0,1,\infty\} = \emptyset. Moreover, if X, S, and T are defined over a number field F, then \phi may be taken to be defined over F.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp. 5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_aeval_mem`

Let K be a field of characteristic zero, and let P be a proper valuation subring O_P of K containing all rational constants. For any x ∈ K lying in O_P and any polynomial p with rational coefficients, evaluation p(x), formed in K by the canonical rational algebra structure, also lies in O_P. There is no curve-field, transcendence, degree, or nonzero hypothesis. The body expands polynomial evaluation as a finite sum and uses closure of O_P under rational constants, powers, multiplication, and addition. This is a complete proof body in the inspected text; it has not been compiled in this review.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_residue_aeval`

Let K be a field of characteristic zero, let P be a proper valuation subring O_P containing ℚ, and let res_P : O_P → κ(P) be the actual residue map to the full residue field κ(P). For every x ∈ O_P and every p ∈ ℚ[X], reducing the evaluated element p(x) gives the same result as evaluating p at res_P(x) in κ(P): res_P(p(x)) = p(res_P(x)). The membership proof for p(x) is the preceding helper. This concerns the full residue field, without choosing an embedding into ℚ̄. No curve-field, transcendence, nonzero, or degree assumption is present. The complete body uses compatibility of polynomial evaluation with ring homomorphisms and uniqueness of the rational ring homomorphism; it is not compilation-verified here.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_isIntegral_residue`

Let K be a field of characteristic zero with IsCurveField K: there exists t ∈ K transcendental over ℚ such that K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(t). Let P be any proper valuation subring O_P of K containing ℚ, and let κ(P) be its full actual residue field. For every a ∈ O_P, the residue res_P(a) is integral over ℚ; equivalently, it satisfies a monic polynomial with rational coefficients. The existing curve-field theory supplies finite-dimensionality of κ(P) over ℚ, so residue finiteness is not a further hypothesis of this theorem. No assumption that the constant field equals ℚ, no residue embedding choice, and no transcendence or nonzero condition on a occurs. The one-line proof body is complete in the text; no compilation was performed.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero`

Let K be a characteristic-zero field which is finite-dimensional over ℚ(t) for some t transcendental over ℚ. Let P be any proper valuation subring O_P of K containing ℚ, with actual residue map res_P to the full residue field κ(P). For y ∈ K, assume y ∈ O_P, y ≠ 0, and res_P(y) = 0. Then the normalized integer order ord_P(y) is strictly positive. The curve-field hypothesis supplies the discrete valuation ring used for this order. The definition has ord_P(0)=0, so the nonzero hypothesis on y is essential to the stated implication. The body identifies the kernel of the residue map with the maximal ideal and applies the positive-order characterization for nonzero elements. It is complete textually and has not been compiled here.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationPositive`

Let N be a natural number and M : Model N. Thus M.K is an intermediate field of the algebraic closure of ℚ(t), with elements u and v such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N + v^N = 1, ℚ(u,v) = M.K, and M.K is finite of degree N over ℚ(u). Let hDVR assert that every place has a discrete valuation ring. A place P is a proper valuation subring O_P of M.K containing ℚ; no affine restriction is imposed. Write κ(P) for its full residue field and res_P : O_P → κ(P) for the actual residue map. The integer ord_P is the normalized discrete order, with the convention ord_P(0) = 0. For any f ∈ M.K, define the integer e_P(f) as ord_P(q(f)) when f ∈ O_P, where q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)), and as −ord_P(f) when f ∉ O_P. This is the actual definition of ramIdx M hDVR f P. For every ψ ∈ M.K transcendental over ℚ and every place P, the theorem states e_P(ψ) > 0. At a nonpole, finite-dimensionality of the full residue field over ℚ follows from the model-derived curve-field structure, so its residue is integral over ℚ and its minimal polynomial q is nonzero. Transcendence of ψ implies q(ψ) ≠ 0. The evaluated element q(ψ) lies in O_P and has zero residue because q annihilates res_P(ψ). Its nonzero status is what allows zero residue to imply strictly positive order despite ord_P(0)=0. At a pole, ord_P(ψ)<0, hence −ord_P(ψ)>0. This complete proof body adds no assumption beyond the displayed type: in particular no separately supplied residue-finiteness, constant-field, derivative, or composition law. The source comments identify it as an adaptation of ramIdx_pos; this review establishes the body and dependency shape statically, not by compilation or an upstream comparison.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_aeval_mem`

设 K 是特征为零的域，P 是 K 中包含全部有理常数且不等于整个域的赋值子环 O_P。对任意属于 O_P 的元素 x ∈ K 和任意有理系数多项式 p，通过规范的有理数代数结构在 K 中计算的多项式值 p(x) 仍属于 O_P。不要求 K 是曲线函数域，也没有超越性、次数或非零假设。证明将多项式求值展开为有限和，再使用 O_P 对有理常数、幂、乘法和加法的封闭性。所读文本中的证明体完整；本次审阅没有编译。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_residue_aeval`

设 K 是特征为零的域，P 是包含 ℚ 且不等于 K 的赋值子环 O_P，res_P : O_P → κ(P) 是通向完整剩余域 κ(P) 的实际剩余映射。对每个 x ∈ O_P 和每个 p ∈ ℚ[X]，先在 K 中求值再取剩余类，与先取 x 的剩余类再在 κ(P) 中求值，结果相同：res_P(p(x)) = p(res_P(x))。p(x) 属于 O_P 由前一个辅助定理保证。这里使用完整剩余域，没有选择到 ℚ̄ 的嵌入。没有曲线函数域、超越性、非零或次数假设。完整证明使用多项式求值与环同态的相容性，以及有理数环同态的唯一性；本次没有通过编译验证。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_isIntegral_residue`

设 K 是特征为零的域，并满足 IsCurveField K：存在在 ℚ 上超越的 t ∈ K，使 K 是 ℚ(t) 上的有限维扩张。设 P 是 K 中任意包含 ℚ 且不等于整个域的赋值子环 O_P，κ(P) 是它的完整实际剩余域。对每个 a ∈ O_P，剩余类 res_P(a) 都在 ℚ 上整，即满足某个有理系数首一多项式。已有曲线函数域理论保证 κ(P) 在 ℚ 上有限维，因此本定理没有另行假设剩余域的有限性。这里不要求常数域等于 ℚ，不选择剩余域嵌入，也不要求 a 超越或非零。文本中的单行证明体完整；本次未编译。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero`

设 K 是特征为零的域，并且对某个在 ℚ 上超越的 t，K 是 ℚ(t) 上的有限维扩张。设 P 是 K 中任意包含 ℚ 且不等于整个域的赋值子环 O_P，其实际剩余映射 res_P 通向完整剩余域 κ(P)。给定 y ∈ K，假设 y ∈ O_P、y ≠ 0 且 res_P(y) = 0，则规范化整数阶 ord_P(y) 严格大于零。曲线函数域假设提供定义此阶所需的离散赋值环。定义约定 ord_P(0)=0，因此陈述中的非零假设不能省去。证明利用剩余映射的核等于极大理想，再对非零元素应用正阶的刻画。文本证明完整；本次未编译。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationPositive`

设 N 为自然数，M : Model N。也就是说，M.K 是 ℚ(t) 的代数闭包中的中间域，带有元素 u、v，满足 u 在 ℚ 上超越，u^N + v^N = 1，ℚ(u,v) = M.K，且 M.K 是 ℚ(u) 的 N 次有限扩张。设 hDVR 表示每个赋值点的赋值环都是离散赋值环。赋值点 P 是 M.K 中包含 ℚ 且不等于整个域的赋值子环 O_P；这里没有仿射开集限制。记 κ(P) 为它的完整剩余域，res_P : O_P → κ(P) 为实际剩余映射。整数 ord_P 是规范化离散阶，并约定 ord_P(0) = 0。对任意 f ∈ M.K，若 f ∈ O_P，令 q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f))，并定义整数 e_P(f) = ord_P(q(f))；若 f ∉ O_P，则定义 e_P(f) = −ord_P(f)。这正是 ramIdx M hDVR f P 的定义。对每个在 ℚ 上超越的 ψ ∈ M.K 和每个赋值点 P，定理断言 e_P(ψ) > 0。在非极点情形，模型导出的曲线函数域结构保证完整剩余域在 ℚ 上有限维，因此剩余类在 ℚ 上整，其最小多项式 q 非零。ψ 的超越性保证 q(ψ) ≠ 0。求值元素 q(ψ) 属于 O_P；由于 q 消去 res_P(ψ)，它的剩余类为零。正是 q(ψ) 的非零性，使剩余类为零能够推出严格正阶，而不受 ord_P(0)=0 这一约定影响。在极点情形，ord_P(ψ)<0，所以 −ord_P(ψ)>0。这个完整证明没有增加类型中所列假设之外的条件，尤其没有另行输入剩余域有限性、常数域条件、导数理论或复合规律。源码注释称其改编自 ramIdx_pos；本次仅静态确认了证明体及依赖结构，没有编译，也没有与上游逐项比较。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_aeval_mem`

K を標数 0 の体とし、P を、有理定数をすべて含み K 全体とは異なる付値部分環 O_P とする。O_P に属する任意の元 x ∈ K と任意の有理数係数多項式 p に対し、標準的な ℚ 代数構造によって K 内で求めた値 p(x) も O_P に属する。曲線関数体、超越性、次数、非零性の仮定はない。証明は多項式の値を有限和に展開し、O_P が有理定数、冪、積、和について閉じていることを用いる。読んだテキストの証明本体は完結している。本審査ではコンパイルしていない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_residue_aeval`

K を標数 0 の体、P を ℚ を含み K 全体とは異なる付値部分環 O_P とし、res_P : O_P → κ(P) を剰余体全体 κ(P) への実際の剰余写像とする。すべての x ∈ O_P と p ∈ ℚ[X] に対し、K で p(x) を求めてから剰余を取る操作と、res_P(x) において κ(P) 内で p を評価する操作は一致する。すなわち res_P(p(x)) = p(res_P(x)) である。p(x) の O_P への所属は先の補助定理で与えられる。対象は剰余体全体であり、ℚ̄ への埋め込みを選んでいない。曲線関数体、超越性、非零性、次数の仮定はない。完結した証明は、多項式評価と環準同型の整合性、および ℚ からの環準同型の一意性を用いる。本審査ではコンパイルによる検証をしていない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_isIntegral_residue`

K を標数 0 の体とし、IsCurveField K を仮定する。すなわち、ℚ 上超越的な t ∈ K が存在し、K は ℚ(t) 上有限次元である。P を、ℚ を含み K 全体とは異なる任意の付値部分環 O_P とし、κ(P) をその実際の剰余体全体とする。すべての a ∈ O_P に対し、剰余 res_P(a) は ℚ 上整である。つまり、有理数係数のあるモニック多項式を満たす。既存の曲線関数体の理論から κ(P) の ℚ 上の有限次元性が得られるため、剰余体の有限性は本定理の追加仮定ではない。定数体が ℚ と等しいという仮定、剰余体埋め込みの選択、a の超越性や非零性の条件はない。テキストの一行の証明本体は完結している。本審査ではコンパイルしていない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place.noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero`

K を標数 0 の体とし、ℚ 上超越的なある t に対して K が ℚ(t) 上有限次元であると仮定する。P を、ℚ を含み K 全体とは異なる任意の付値部分環 O_P とし、res_P を剰余体全体 κ(P) への実際の剰余写像とする。y ∈ K に対し、y ∈ O_P、y ≠ 0、res_P(y) = 0 を仮定すると、正規化された整数位数 ord_P(y) は正である。曲線関数体の仮定によって、この位数の定義に用いる離散付値環が得られる。ord_P(0)=0 という定義のため、述べられた含意には y ≠ 0 が必要である。証明は、剰余写像の核が極大イデアルであることを用い、非零元に対する正の位数の特徴づけを適用する。テキスト上の証明は完結しているが、本審査ではコンパイルしていない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationPositive`

N を自然数、M : Model N とする。M.K は ℚ(t) の代数閉包の中間体であり、元 u、v は、u が ℚ 上超越的、u^N + v^N = 1、ℚ(u,v) = M.K、かつ M.K が ℚ(u) 上 N 次の有限拡大という条件を満たす。hDVR は、すべての付値点の付値環が離散付値環であることを表す。付値点 P は、ℚ を含み M.K 全体とは異なる付値部分環 O_P であり、アフィン開集合への制限はない。κ(P) はその剰余体全体、res_P : O_P → κ(P) は実際の剰余写像である。整数 ord_P は正規化された離散位数であり、ord_P(0) = 0 と定める。f ∈ M.K に対し、f ∈ O_P ならば q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)) として整数 e_P(f) = ord_P(q(f))、f ∉ O_P ならば e_P(f) = −ord_P(f) と定める。これが ramIdx M hDVR f P の定義である。ℚ 上超越的なすべての ψ ∈ M.K とすべての付値点 P に対し、この定理は e_P(ψ) > 0 を述べる。極でない場合、モデルから得られる曲線関数体の構造により、剰余体全体は ℚ 上有限次元である。したがって ψ の剰余は ℚ 上整で、その最小多項式 q は非零である。ψ の超越性から q(ψ) ≠ 0 が従う。q(ψ) は O_P に属し、q が res_P(ψ) を零にするため、その剰余は零である。ord_P(0)=0 と定めているにもかかわらず、剰余が零であることから正の位数を導けるのは、q(ψ) が非零だからである。極の場合には ord_P(ψ)<0 であり、−ord_P(ψ)>0 が従う。完結した証明本体は、表示した型の仮定以外を追加していない。剰余体の有限性、定数体の条件、微分の理論、合成則を別の入力として要求していない。ソースのコメントでは ramIdx_pos の移植とされている。本審査は証明本体と依存関係の静的な確認であり、コンパイルや上流との照合は行っていない。

/-
Copyright (c) 2026 The Belyi project contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The Belyi project contributors

Independent namespace adaptation of Belyi/CurveField/NoncriticalBasic.lean ramIdx_pos and necessary residue-polynomial helpers.
Pinned Belyi: 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8.
Upstream: https://github.com/lana-agents/belyi.
Source SHA-256: NoncriticalBasic=0bbc09343228185b5c499b9f4563dbcb69fd6338e7b05c107ad784149bfc01a3; RamIdx=14ad110ef89ced20c49856589f6c586bb93a7fa6ec7bfb9eb606ba7b023cd4f6; CurveDeriv.Local=cb930e45cba81a1377ab8281264d938868ae7834d32c480a9af9d29012eb1aae.
-/
import Definitions.Def_FermatNoncriticalFunctions
import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Hom.Rat

set_option autoImplicit false

open Polynomial

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

namespace Place

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (P : Place K)

/-- Source CurveDeriv/Local.lean `aeval_mem`, specialized to the actual
valuation ring of P. Only this polynomial-membership proof is reused;
no derivative carrier or local derivative theorem is imported. -/
theorem noncritical_aeval_mem {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) : aeval x p ∈ P.1 := by
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range]
  refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  exact mul_mem (P.algebraMap_mem _) (pow_mem hx _)

/-- Source CurveField/RamIdx.lean `residue_aeval`, using the actual residue map. -/
theorem noncritical_residue_aeval {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) :
    P.residue ⟨aeval x p, P.noncritical_aeval_mem hx p⟩ =
      aeval (P.residue ⟨x, hx⟩) p := by
  have h1 : (⟨aeval x p, P.noncritical_aeval_mem hx p⟩ : P.1) =
      eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hx⟩ p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change aeval x p = P.1.subtype (eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hx⟩ p)
    rw [hom_eval₂, aeval_def]
    congr 1
  rw [h1, hom_eval₂, aeval_def]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext_rat _ _

variable [IsCurveField K]

/-- Source CurveField/RamIdx.lean `isIntegral_residue`; finiteness of the
full actual residue field is supplied by the existing curve-field instance. -/
theorem noncritical_isIntegral_residue (a : P.1) : IsIntegral ℚ (P.residue a) :=
  Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _

/-- Source NoncriticalBasic.lean `ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero`. -/
theorem noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero {y : K} (hy : y ∈ P.1) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (h : P.residue ⟨y, hy⟩ = 0) : 0 < P.ord y :=
  (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨y, hy⟩) hy0).mpr
    ((P.residue_eq_zero_iff).mp h)

end Place

/-- Source NoncriticalBasic.lean `ramIdx_pos`, at the existing model's
actual residue-minpoly/pole index. This is a completed source proof. -/
theorem noncriticalRamificationPositive {N : ℕ} (M : Model N)
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (ψ : M.K) (hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ)
    (P : Place M.K) : 0 < ramIdx M hDVR ψ P := by
  letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField
  unfold ramIdx
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [ord_eq_placeOrd]
    have hr := P.noncritical_isIntegral_residue ⟨ψ, h⟩
    have hm0 : aeval ψ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨ψ, h⟩)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h0 => hψ ⟨_, minpoly.ne_zero hr, h0⟩
    refine P.noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero (P.noncritical_aeval_mem h _) hm0 ?_
    rw [P.noncritical_residue_aeval h]
    exact minpoly.aeval ℚ _
  · rw [ord_eq_placeOrd]
    have := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
    omega

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper
nodes.source: Shinichi Mochizuki, Noncritical Belyi Maps (May 2004), Theorem 2.5, https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Noncritical%20Belyi%20Maps.pdf . The checked original quotation supplies geometric context for noncritical maps. The exact residue/minpoly indices, elementary-map value and ramification identities, and list induction come from the pinned Lean implementation: lana-agents/belyi at 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8, from refer/iut/lake-manifest.json. Source files retain their Apache-2.0 headers and author notices. The actual single-elementary-map composition theorem remains Open; the parent combines source positivity and list induction. The parent keeps its exact existing type and all actual residue embeddings. No Belyi, Heights, Iut, or Genl runtime dependency is added. Belyi/CurveField/NoncriticalBasic.lean ramIdx_pos, CurveField/RamIdx.lean residue_aeval and isIntegral_residue, and the elementary aeval_mem proof from CurveDeriv/Local.lean. Four concrete residue/polynomial helpers supply source positivity of the existing actual index at every place. The regular branch uses the full residue-field minimal polynomial and the pole branch uses negative normalized order. The construction uses no derivative carrier and imports no Open theorem.

nodes.theorem_title: Actual affine generators for the Belyi cusp complement
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspGeneratorsExists : ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M),
  AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (φ : ↥M.K),
      AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsBelyi M hDVR φ →
        ∀ (hfin : (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cusps M hDVR φ).Finite),
          Nonempty (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.CuspGenerators M hDVR φ hfin) := by sorry

> Write $D \overset{\mathrm{def}}{=} \sum_{t\in T}[t]$ for the effective divisor on X obtained by taking the formal sum of the points in T, each with multiplicity one; denote the associated line bundle $\mathcal{O}_X(D)$ by $\mathcal{L}$ and the canonical bundle of X by $\omega_X$.

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p.6.

Source context: https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Noncritical%20Belyi%20Maps.pdf . PDF SHA256 d59b8bf5bbed7fea124345330ad81df284747457c03d7cb07baa0f4ebd38ce2c. The quotation supplies the divisor and canonical-bundle context; the exact coordinate-ring finite-generation construction below is an independently adapted formal-source argument.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspGeneratorsExists`

Let N be a natural number and M a Model N. Thus K=M.K is an intermediate field between ℚ and the fixed algebraic closure Ω of ℚ(X), with elements u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, K=ℚ(u,v), and K is finite-dimensional of dimension N over ℚ(u). A place P ranges over all proper valuation subrings O_P⊊K containing ℚ, including those at infinity; membership f∈O_P means regularity at P. Let hDVR assert that every O_P is a discrete valuation ring, and write ord_P(f) for its normalized integer order, with ord_P(0)=0. A divisor A is a finitely supported integer-valued function on all these places. Put deg(A)=∑_P A(P)[κ(P):ℚ], where κ(P) is the actual residue field of O_P and the weight is its ℚ-vector-space dimension; A≥0 means A(P)≥0 for every P. For a divisor D, let R_D={f∈K | for every place P, D(P)=0 implies f∈O_P}, regarded as its full ℚ-subalgebra of K. For φ∈K put C_φ={P | ord_P(φ)≠0 or ord_P(φ−1)>0}. When hfin proves C_φ finite, let D_φ=∑_{P∈C_φ}[P] be the reduced cusp divisor. Assume hRF: for every place P, the actual residue field κ(P) is finite-dimensional as a vector space over ℚ. This is a finite-dimensionality assertion, not finiteness of the underlying set. Let φ∈K satisfy IsBelyi M hDVR φ: φ is transcendental over ℚ, and every place P whose ramification index e_φ(P) is greater than 1 belongs to C_φ. Here e_φ(P)=ord_P(m_P(φ)) if φ∈O_P, where m_P is the minimal polynomial over ℚ of the residue of φ in κ(P); if φ∉O_P, then e_φ(P)=−ord_P(φ). Given any proof hfin that C_φ is finite, CuspGenerators M hDVR φ hfin is inhabited: there exists a finite G⊆K containing φ, φ⁻¹ and (1−φ)⁻¹ such that ℚ[G]=R_{D_φ} as the complete ℚ-subalgebra of all functions regular at every place outside C_φ. No additional lower bound on N appears beyond the existence of the stated Model N.

nodes.natural_language_statement:
> “Moreover, if $X$, $S$, and $T$ are defined over a number field $F$, then $\phi$ may be taken to be defined over $F$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp.5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspConductorHeightComparison`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $F$ be an intermediate field between $\mathbb Q$ and an algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q(T)$, with elements $u,v$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$, and $F$ is finite-dimensional of dimension $N$ over $\mathbb Q(u)$. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P\ne F$ containing every rational number; write $k_P$ for its residue field. Assume every $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring and every $k_P$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. For $f\in F$, put $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$, where $V_P$ is the valuation on $F$ from the maximal ideal of $O_P$ and $\log_0$ is the integer-valued total logarithm called `WithZero.log` in the code, and put $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$. Define $e_P(f)=o_P(\mu_{\bar f}(f))$ if $f\in O_P$, where $\bar f\in k_P$ is its residue and $\mu_{\bar f}$ is its minimal polynomial over $\mathbb Q$; if $f\notin O_P$, define $e_P(f)=-o_P(f)$. Let $\varphi\in F$ be transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, with $e_P(\varphi)>1$ implying $P\in S$ for every $P$, where $S=\{P:o_P(\varphi)\ne0\text{ or }o_P(\varphi-1)>0\}$. Assume $S$ is finite, with its finiteness proof supplied as data, and let $E(P)=1$ on $S$ and $E(P)=0$ elsewhere. Let $G\subset F$ be a finite set whose generated $\mathbb Q$-subalgebra is exactly $\{f\in F: f\in O_P\text{ for all }P\notin S\}$ and which contains $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(1-\varphi)^{-1}$. A point $x$ consists of such a place $P_x$ and a ring homomorphism $\sigma_x:k_{P_x}\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$; for $f\in O_{P_x}$ write $f(x)=\sigma_x(\bar f)$, put $L_x=\sigma_x(k_{P_x})$ and $d_x=[L_x:\mathbb Q]$. Let $A$ be any bijection from the points $x$ for which $u,v\in O_{P_x}$ and $u(x),v(x)\ne0$ to the pairs $p=(a,b)\in\overline{\mathbb Q}^{2}$ with $a^N+b^N=1$ and $a,b\ne0$, such that $A(x)=(u(x),v(x))$ for every choice of regularity proofs and $L_x=\mathbb Q(a,b)$. Write $x_p$ for the underlying point of $A^{-1}(p)$, $F_p=\mathbb Q(a,b)$ and $d_p=[F_p:\mathbb Q]$. For an algebraic number $z$, write $h(z)=\operatorname{logHeight}_1(z\text{ viewed in }\mathbb Q(z))/\deg(\mu_z)$, where $\mu_z$ is its minimal polynomial over $\mathbb Q$. Set $H_f(x)=h(f(x))$ if $f\in O_{P_x}$ and $H_f(x)=0$ otherwise. A presentation $R=(f,g)$ of a divisor $B$ means $B(P)=m_P(f)-m_P(g)$ at every place, and its height is $h_R(x)=H_f(x)-H_g(x)$; zero functions and common poles are not excluded. Define $c_G(x)=0$ if some $g\in G$ is not in $O_{P_x}$; otherwise define $c_G(x)=d_x^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{\exists g\in G:\,w(g(x))>1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$, over all finite places $w$ of $L_x$, using the finite-support sum (which is defined to be zero when the summand has infinite support). Thus only the strict inequality $w(g(x))>1$ is counted. The conclusion below concerns only $p$ for which $\varphi\in O_{P_{x_p}}$ and $z_p=\varphi(x_p)\notin\{0,1\}$. The code defines its image to be $z_p$ in this case, and the rational number $2$ otherwise; the latter branch is outside the conclusion's hypotheses. For every presentation $R_E$ of $E$, there exists $C\in\mathbb R$, independent of $p$, such that $c_G(x_p)\le h_{R_E}(x_p)+C$ for every such good-value pair $p$. No hypothesis $N>3$ is imposed and no regularity condition is imposed on the two functions in $R_E$; the zero branches in the definitions of both the conductor and function heights remain in force. Here $\mathfrak p_w$ is the maximal ideal associated with the finite place $w$, and its norm is the absolute ideal norm.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspConductorHeightComparison`

子代数恰为 $\{f\in F: \text{对所有 }P\notin S,\ f\in O_P\}$，并且 $G$ 包含 $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(1-\varphi)^{-1}$。点 $x$ 由这样的位 $P_x$ 及环同态 $\sigma_x:k_{P_x}\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 组成；当 $f\in O_{P_x}$ 时，记 $f(x)=\sigma_x(\bar f)$，并令 $L_x=\sigma_x(k_{P_x})$、$d_x=[L_x:\mathbb Q]$。设 $A$ 为任意双射，将满足 $u,v\in O_{P_x}$ 且 $u(x),v(x)\ne0$ 的点 $x$ 映到满足 $a^N+b^N=1$ 且 $a,b\ne0$ 的数对 $p=(a,b)\in\overline{\mathbb $L_x$ 的所有有限位 $w$，使用有限支撑求和，求和项的支撑无限时该和按定义为零。因此只有严格不等式 $w(g(x))>1$ 被计入。下面的结论仅涉及满足 $\varphi\in O_{P_{x_p}}$ 且 $z_p=\varphi(x_p)\notin\{0,1\}$ 的 $p$。代码在这种情形把其像定义为 $z_p$，否则定义为有理数 $2$；后一分支不满足此结论的假设。对 $E$ が成り立つことをいい、その高さを $h_R(x)=H_f(x)-H_g(x)$ とする。零関数や共通の極は排除されていない。ある $g\in G$ が $O_{P_x}$ に属さなければ $c_G(x)=0$ とし、それ以外では $c_G(x)=d_x^{-1}\sum_w^{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbf1_{\exists g\in G:\,w(g(x))>1}\log\operatorname{Norm}(\mathfrak p_w)$ と定める。ここで $w$ は $L_x$ の有限素点全体を動き、有限台の和を用いる。この和は被加算関数の台が無限であれば定義により零である。したがって厳密な不等式 $w(g(x))>1$ のみを数える。以下の結論は $\varphi\in O_{P_{x_p}}$ かつ $z_p=\varphi(x_p)\notin\{0,1\}$ を満たす $p$ のみに関する。コードはこの場合の像を $z_p$、それ以外の像を有理数 $2$ と定義するが、後者の分岐は結論の仮定に含まれない。$E$ の任意の表示 $R_E$ に対し、$p$ に依存しない実数 $C$ が存在し、そのような良い値をもつすべての組 $p$ について $c_G(x_p)\le h_{R_E}(x_p)+C$ が成り立つ。$N>3$ は仮定せず、$R_E$ の二つの関数に正則性も要求しない。導手と関数の高さの定義における零の分岐はそのまま適用される。ここで $\mathfrak p_w$ は有限素点 $w$ に対応する極大イデアルであり、そのノルムはイデアルの絶対ノルムである。

> “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannDefectSup`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Define riemannDefectSup M hDVR as the integer supremum of the set {deg(A)−ℓ(A) | A is a divisor}. This definition itself imposes no boundedness or attainment hypothesis.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Write (f), (f)₀ and (f)∞ for the finite-support divisors of coefficients ord_P(f), max(0,ord_P(f)) and max(0,−ord_P(f)), respectively; these are the principal divisor, zero divisor and pole divisor of f. By the order convention all three divisors of the zero function are the zero divisor whose coefficients are all zero. Write [P] for the divisor of coefficient one at P and zero elsewhere. Let b_i=functionBasis M i, indexed by Fin(Module.finrank ℚ(u) K), be the fixed chosen ℚ(u)-basis of K. Write B=(u)∞ and C=Σ_i(b_i)∞ for the pole divisor of the model coordinate u and the fixed basis correction. Assume (i) deg((f))=0 for every f∈M.K; (ii) deg(B)=N as an integer; (iii) for every divisor A there exist nonzero z∈M.K and l∈ℕ with A+(z)≤lB coefficientwise; and (iv) for every l∈ℕ, (l+1)N≤ℓ(lB+C). Then there exist integers g₀,N₀ such that every divisor A of degree at least N₀ satisfies ℓ(A)=deg(A)−g₀ over ℤ.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannDefectSup`

对任意自然数 N 和任意给定模型 M，令 K=M.K 为有理数域与有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的一个固定代数闭包之间的中间域。模型给定 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。除子 A 指 K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数；除子不等式指每个处的系数不等式，若每个处 P 都满足 A(P)≥0，则称 A 有效。记 deg(P) 为剩余域 κ(P) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩，deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P)，其中剩余域次数先转为整数。自然数值有限秩在空间有限维时等于通常的向量空间维数。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。另给定证明 hDVR，断言每个处 P 的赋值环 O_P 都是离散赋值环。对每个除子 A，定义有理数线性子空间 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 或每个处 P 都满足 ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}，并记 ℓ(A) 为 L(A) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩。将 riemannDefectSup M hDVR 定义为整数集合 {deg(A)−ℓ(A) | A 为除子} 的上确界。该定义本身没有有界性或取到上确界的假设。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis`

对任意自然数 N 和任意给定模型 M，令 K=M.K 为有理数域与有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的一个固定代数闭包之间的中间域。模型给定 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。除子 A 指 K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数；除子不等式指每个处的系数不等式，若每个处 P 都满足 A(P)≥0，则称 A 有效。记 deg(P) 为剩余域 κ(P) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩，deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P)，其中剩余域次数先转为整数。自然数值有限秩在空间有限维时等于通常的向量空间维数。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。另给定证明 hDVR，断言每个处 P 的赋值环 O_P 都是离散赋值环。对每个除子 A，定义有理数线性子空间 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 或每个处 P 都满足 ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}，并记 ℓ(A) 为 L(A) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩。记 (f)、(f)₀、(f)∞ 分别为逐处系数为 ord_P(f)、max(0,ord_P(f))、max(0,−ord_P(f)) 的有限支撑除子，分别称主除子、零点除子、极点除子。按阶的约定，零函数的这三个除子都等于所有系数均为零的零除子。记 [P] 为在 P 处系数为一且其余系数为零的除子。令 b_i=functionBasis M i 为 K 在 ℚ(u) 上固定选定的基，以 Fin(Module.finrank ℚ(u) K) 为指标。记 B=(u)∞ 为模型坐标 u 的极点除子，C=Σ_i(b_i)∞ 为固定基的极点修正除子。假设：（一）每个 f∈M.K 都满足 deg((f))=0；（二）deg(B)=(N:ℤ)；（三）对每个除子 A，存在非零 z∈M.K 和自然数 l，使逐处系数满足 A+(z)≤lB；（四）对每个自然数 l，有 (l+1)N≤ℓ(lB+C)。则存在整数 g₀,N₀，使每个次数至少为 N₀ 的除子 A 都满足整数等式 ℓ(A)=deg(A)−g₀。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannDefectSup`

任意の自然数 N と与えられた任意の模型 M に対し、K=M.K を有理数体と有理関数体 ℚ(X) の固定された代数閉包との間の中間体とする。模型は u,v∈K を与え、u は有理数体上超越的であり、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K は ℚ(u) 上有限次元かつ [K:ℚ(u)]=N を満たす。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。因子 A とは K の全ての素点上の有限台を持つ整数値関数である。因子の不等式は各係数の不等式を表し、全ての素点 P で A(P)≥0 なら A を有効という。deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P)、deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P) と書き、剰余体の次数は整数に型変換する。Module.finrank は自然数値の有限階数であり、空間が有限次元なら通常のベクトル空間の次元と一致する。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。全ての素点 P で O_P が離散付値環であることの任意の証明 hDVR を指定する。各因子 A に対し、有理数線形部分空間 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 または全ての素点 P で ord_P(f)≥−A(P)} を定め、ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A) と書く。riemannDefectSup M hDVR を整数集合 {deg(A)−ℓ(A) | A は因子} の上限と定める。この定義自体は有界性も上限が達成されることも仮定しない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis`

任意の自然数 N と与えられた任意の模型 M に対し、K=M.K を有理数体と有理関数体 ℚ(X) の固定された代数閉包との間の中間体とする。模型は u,v∈K を与え、u は有理数体上超越的であり、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K は ℚ(u) 上有限次元かつ [K:ℚ(u)]=N を満たす。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。因子 A とは K の全ての素点上の有限台を持つ整数値関数である。因子の不等式は各係数の不等式を表し、全ての素点 P で A(P)≥0 なら A を有効という。deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P)、deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P) と書き、剰余体の次数は整数に型変換する。Module.finrank は自然数値の有限階数であり、空間が有限次元なら通常のベクトル空間の次元と一致する。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。全ての素点 P で O_P が離散付値環であることの任意の証明 hDVR を指定する。各因子 A に対し、有理数線形部分空間 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 または全ての素点 P で ord_P(f)≥−A(P)} を定め、ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A) と書く。(f)、(f)₀、(f)∞ をそれぞれ各素点での係数が ord_P(f)、max(0,ord_P(f))、max(0,−ord_P(f)) となる有限台の因子とし、主因子、零点の因子、極の因子と呼ぶ。位数の規約により、零関数のこれら三つの因子は全ての係数が零である零因子となる。[P] は P での係数が一で他では零である因子を表す。b_i=functionBasis M i を K の ℚ(u) 上の固定された選択済み基底とし、添字集合を Fin(Module.finrank ℚ(u) K) とする。模型の座標 u の極の因子を B=(u)∞、固定された基底の補正因子を C=Σ_i(b_i)∞ と書く。(i) 全ての f∈M.K で deg((f))=0、(ii) 整数として deg(B)=N、(iii) 全ての因子 A に対して非零元 z∈M.K と自然数 l が存在し各係数で A+(z)≤lB、(iv) 全ての自然数 l で (l+1)N≤ℓ(lB+C) が成立すると仮定する。このとき整数 g₀,N₀ が存在し、次数が N₀ 以上の全ての因子 A で整数の等式 ℓ(A)=deg(A)−g₀ が成立する。

Source proof adaptation: Belyi/CurveField/Riemann.lean:158-282 at
9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8.
-/
import Definitions.Def_FermatRiemannLocalDimension
import Mathlib.Data.Int.ConditionallyCompleteOrder

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

variable {N : ℕ}

/-- The supremum of the actual integer defects. It receives no free genus
or dimension parameter. Boundedness and attainment are proved below. -/
noncomputable def riemannDefectSup (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) : ℤ :=
  sSup (Set.range fun A : Divisor M =>
    divisorDegree M A - (riemannEll M hDVR A : ℤ))

/-- The three geometric inputs control actual divisors, actual function
values, and dimensions of actual Riemann–Roch spaces. Their source proof
implies eventual linearity without a separate genus axiom. -/
theorem riemannEventuallyLinear_of_degree_approximation_basis
    (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (hDegreeZero : ∀ f : M.K, divisorDegree M (functionDivisor M hDVR f) = 0)
    (hPoleDegree : divisorDegree M (functionPoleDivisor M hDVR M.u) = (N : ℤ))
    (hApprox : ∀ A : Divisor M, ∃ z : M.K, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ l : ℕ,
      A + functionDivisor M hDVR z ≤ l • functionPoleDivisor M hDVR M.u)
    (hBasis : ∀ l : ℕ, (l + 1) * N ≤
      riemannEll M hDVR (l • functionPoleDivisor M hDVR M.u +
        basisPoleCorrection M hDVR)) :
    ∃ g0 N0 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor M, N0 ≤ divisorDegree M A →
      (riemannEll M hDVR A : ℤ) = divisorDegree M A - g0 := by
  letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField
  let B := functionPoleDivisor M hDVR M.u
  let C := basisPoleCorrection M hDVR
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := basisPoleCorrection_nonneg M hDVR
  have hPolarBound : ∃ γ : ℤ, ∀ l : ℕ,
      divisorDegree M (l • B) - (riemannEll M hDVR (l • B) : ℤ) ≤ γ := by
    refine ⟨divisorDegree M C - N, fun l => ?_⟩
    have hcard := hBasis l
    have hdegD : divisorDegree M (l • B + C) = (l : ℤ) * N + divisorDegree M C := by
      rw [divisorDegree_add, divisorDegree_nsmul]
      dsimp only [B]
      rw [hPoleDegree]
    have hmono := RiemannDimension.degreeDefect_mono M hDVR hDegreeZero
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right hC : l • B ≤ l • B + C)
    have hcard' : ((l : ℤ) + 1) * N ≤ riemannEll M hDVR (l • B + C) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcard
    have hexpand : ((l : ℤ) + 1) * N = (l : ℤ) * N + N := by ring
    omega
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hPolarBound
  have hAllBound : ∀ A : Divisor M,

import Definitions.Def_FermatLocalBelyiComposition
import Definitions.Def_FermatProperDivisorHeight

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

/-- The actual canonical divisor has the Fermat canonical degree. The
infinity and adjunction data are concrete inputs to this identity. -/
def CanonicalDegreeIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M), 3 < N →
    ResiduesFinite M → ∀ (K : CanonicalDivisorData M hDVR)
      (H : InfinityDivisorData M hDVR),
      PlaneAdjunctionData M hDVR K H →
      divisorDegree M K.D = planeCanonicalDegree N

/-- Explicit identification of the true canonical divisor height with the
existing fixed projective Fermat height. No identity is presumed by a name. -/
def CanonicalHeightIdentification : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M), 3 < N →
    ResiduesFinite M → ∀ (A : AffineIdentification M)
      (K : CanonicalDivisorData M hDVR) (H : InfinityDivisorData M hDVR),
      PlaneAdjunctionData M hDVR K H →
      ∀ RK : PolarPresentation M hDVR K.D,
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : Fermat.Pt N,
        |divHeight RK (affineLift M A p) - Fermat.canonicalHeight p| ≤ C

/-- The actual Belyi canonical+cusp height relation on the good open part. -/
def BelyiHeightRelation : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M), ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (A : AffineIdentification M) (φ : M.K), IsBelyi M hDVR φ →
      ∀ (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite)
        (B : ArithmeticDivisorChoices M hDVR φ hfin),
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : Fermat.Pt N, GoodValue M (affineLift M A p) φ →
        |divHeight B.canonicalPresentation (affineLift M A p) +
            divHeight B.cuspPresentation (affineLift M A p) -
            Tripod.htCan (belyiImage M φ (affineLift M A p))| ≤ C

/-- The genuine strict degree comparison of heights on a curve. Both
functions are computed from exact polar presentations of actual divisors. -/
def DivisorDegreeHeightComparison : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M), ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (D E : Divisor M) (RD : PolarPresentation M hDVR D)
      (RE : PolarPresentation M hDVR E) (q : ℝ),
      0 < divisorDegree M D →
      (divisorDegree M E : ℝ) < q * divisorDegree M D →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : QbarPoint M.K, divHeight RE x ≤ q * divHeight RD x + C

/-- Normalized discriminant/conductor tower inequality for the actual
point fields and actual affine generators; image field degrees can differ. -/
def BelyiDifferentConductorComparison : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M),
    ∀ (A : AffineIdentification M) (φ : M.K), IsBelyi M hDVR φ →
      ∀ (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite)
        (G : CuspGenerators M hDVR φ hfin),
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : Fermat.Pt N, GoodValue M (affineLift M A p) φ →
        Tripod.logDiff (belyiImage M φ (affineLift M A p)) +
          Tripod.logCond (belyiImage M φ (affineLift M A p)) ≤
        Fermat.logDiff p + logCondOf M hRF G.G (affineLift M A p) + C

/-- The actual cusp conductor is bounded by a height of its effective
reduced divisor, uniformly in points on that affine model. -/
def CuspConductorHeightComparison : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M),
    ∀ (A : AffineIdentification M) (φ : M.K), IsBelyi M hDVR φ →
      ∀ (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite)
        (G : CuspGenerators M hDVR φ hfin)
        (RE : PolarPresentation M hDVR (cuspDivisor M hDVR φ hfin)),
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p : Fermat.Pt N, GoodValue M (affineLift M A p) φ →
        logCondOf M hRF G.G (affineLift M A p) ≤
          divHeight RE (affineLift M A p) + C

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

Shinichi Mochizuki, Noncritical Belyi Maps, Theorem 2.5 and Corollary 3.2, pp.5–8; https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Noncritical%20Belyi%20Maps.pdf . Independent concrete Fermat adaptation of Belyi 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8, Heights 721496ca4c158e511d25d8ccf6bfe8503eda73c1, and Genl ea2846c877d1e16d8f0b911a5fed07f5ee69eaaf. No Iut/Genl/Heights/Belyi runtime import is used. Source Genl/Curves/BelyiDescent.lean:215–237,313–327,395–445; Heights.Curve.divHeight_le_mul, Heights.Different.logDisc_add_cond_le and Heights.Curve.logCondOf_le_divHeight. The canonical divisor is div(du), its true degree N(N-3) remains an explicit child, and its actual polar-presentation height is compared to the fixed projective Fermat height. The strict divisor-degree inequality is preserved.

nodes.theorem_title: FermatRiemannSpaces — actual function-field geometry
nodes.natural_language_statement:
> “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochSpace`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). For every divisor A, riemannRochSpace M hDVR A is the ℚ-subspace L(A) defined above. A divisor is an integer-valued function of finite support on all places of M.K.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.mem_riemannRochSpace`

Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.divisorDegree_add`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. the degree of the zero divisor is zero.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochSpace`

对任意自然数 N 和任意给定模型 M，令 K=M.K 为有理数域与有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的一个固定代数闭包之间的中间域。模型给定 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。除子 A 指 K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数；除子不等式指每个处的系数不等式，若每个处 P 都满足 A(P)≥0，则称 A 有效。记 deg(P) 为剩余域 κ(P) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩，deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P)，其中剩余域次数先转为整数。自然数值有限秩在空间有限维时等于通常的向量空间维数。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。另给定证明 hDVR，断言每个处 P 的赋值环 O_P 都是离散赋值环。对每个除子 A，定义有理数线性子空间 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 或每个处 P 都满足 ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}，并记 ℓ(A) 为 L(A) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩。对任意除子 A，riemannRochSpace M hDVR A 定义为上述有理数线性子空间 L(A)。这里除子是 M.K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.riemannRochSpace`

任意の自然数 N と与えられた任意の模型 M に対し、K=M.K を有理数体と有理関数体 ℚ(X) の固定された代数閉包との間の中間体とする。模型は u,v∈K を与え、u は有理数体上超越的であり、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K は ℚ(u) 上有限次元かつ [K:ℚ(u)]=N を満たす。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。因子 A とは K の全ての素点上の有限台を持つ整数値関数である。因子の不等式は各係数の不等式を表し、全ての素点 P で A(P)≥0 なら A を有効という。deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P)、deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P) と書き、剰余体の次数は整数に型変換する。Module.finrank は自然数値の有限階数であり、空間が有限次元なら通常のベクトル空間の次元と一致する。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。全ての素点 P で O_P が離散付値環であることの任意の証明 hDVR を指定する。各因子 A に対し、有理数線形部分空間 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 または全ての素点 P で ord_P(f)≥−A(P)} を定め、ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A) と書く。任意の因子 A に対し、riemannRochSpace M hDVR A を上記の有理数線形部分空間 L(A) と定める。因子とは M.K の全ての素点上の有限台を持つ整数値関数である。

Authors: The Belyi project contributors

Independent adaptation of the L(A) definition in
Belyi/CurveField/RiemannRochSpace.lean at
9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8.
-/
import Definitions.Def_FermatCurveFieldResidue
import Definitions.Def_FermatCurveFieldZerosPoles
import Definitions.Def_FermatProperDivisorHeight
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Finite
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

variable {N : ℕ}

/-- The actual Riemann–Roch subspace. The zero element is included
separately because normalized ord has the source's convention ord(0)=0. -/
def riemannRochSpace (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (A : Divisor M) : Submodule ℚ M.K := by
  letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField
  exact {
    carrier := {f | f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place M.K, -A P ≤ ord M hDVR P f}
    zero_mem' := Or.inl rfl
    add_mem' := by
      rintro f g (rfl | hf) (rfl | hg)
      · simp
      · simpa using Or.inr hg
      · simpa using Or.inr hf
      by_cases hfg : f + g = 0
      · exact Or.inl hfg
      refine Or.inr fun P => ?_
      simp only [ord_eq_placeOrd] at hf hg ⊢
      exact (le_min (hf P) (hg P)).trans (P.min_le_ord_add hfg)
    smul_mem' := by
      rintro q f (rfl | hf)
      · simp
      by_cases h : q • f = 0
      · exact Or.inl h
      refine Or.inr fun P => ?_
      rw [Rat.smul_def] at h ⊢
      have hq : (q : M.K) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul h
      have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h
      rw [ord_eq_placeOrd, P.ord_mul hq hf0, P.ord_ratCast, zero_add]
      simpa only [ord_eq_placeOrd] using hf P }

theorem mem_riemannRochSpace (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (A : Divisor M) (f : M.K) :
    f ∈ riemannRochSpace M hDVR A ↔
      f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place M.K, -A P ≤ ord M hDVR P f := Iff.rfl

theorem riemannRochSpace_mono (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    {A B : Divisor M} (h : A ≤ B) :
    riemannRochSpace M hDVR A ≤ riemannRochSpace M hDVR B := by
  rintro f (rfl | hf)
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  exact Or.inr fun P => (neg_le_neg (h P)).trans (hf P)

/-- The actual rational dimension, not a freely specified genus function.
Every theorem that uses finrank as dimension also takes actual finiteness. -/
noncomputable def riemannEll (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (A : Divisor M) : ℕ := Module.finrank ℚ (riemannRochSpace M hDVR A)

theorem divisorDegree_add (M : Model N) (A B : Divisor M) :
    divisorDegree M (A + B) = divisorDegree M A + divisorDegree M B :=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => zero_mul _) (fun _ _ _ => add_mul _ _ _)

@[simp] theorem divisorDegree_zero (M : Model N) :
    divisorDegree M (0 : Divisor M) = 0 := Finsupp.sum_zero_index

noncomputable def divisorDegreeHom (M : Model N) : Divisor M →+ ℤ where
  toFun := divisorDegree M
  map_zero' := divisorDegree_zero M
  map_add' := divisorDegree_add M

theorem divisorDegree_sub (M : Model N) (A B : Divisor M) :
    divisorDegree M (A - B) = divisorDegree M A - divisorDegree M B :=
  map_sub (divisorDegreeHom M) A B

@[simp] theorem divisorDegree_single (M : Model N) (P : Place M.K) (n : ℤ) :
    divisorDegree M (Finsupp.single P n) = n * P.degree :=
  Finsupp.sum_single_index
    (h := fun (Q : Place M.K) (m : ℤ) => m * (Q.degree : ℤ)) (zero_mul _)

theorem divisorDegree_nonneg (M : Model N) {A : Divisor M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    0 ≤ divisorDegree M A :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun P _ => mul_nonneg (hA P) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)

/-- The finite positive part of an actual divisor. -/
noncomputable def divisorPosPart {M : Model N} (A : Divisor M) : Divisor M :=
  Finsupp.mapRange (fun n => max n 0) (by simp) A

theorem divisorPosPart_apply {M : Model N} (A : Divisor M) (P : Place M.K) :
    divisorPosPart A P = max (A P) 0 := Finsupp.mapRange_apply ..

theorem divisorPosPart_nonneg {M : Model N} (A : Divisor M) :
    0 ≤ divisorPosPart A := fun P => by simp [divisorPosPart_apply]

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

This passage supplies the geometric context of actual divisors, residue-field evaluation and simultaneous nonvanishing. The precise independent Lean constructions and proofs are adapted from Belyi 9ce4d3f793d3bc831f2fc7214b7dbad90ea012d8, pinned by refer/iut, with Apache 2.0 notices retained. The paper passage does not state all implementation details. No Belyi, Genl or Iut runtime import is used. > “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. For every t∈K, chartRing t is the integral closure in K of the ℚ-subalgebra ℚ[t] generated by t.

For each t∈K, ℚ[t] is the ℚ-subalgebra generated by t, and A_t=chartRing t is its integral closure in K, consisting of elements of K integral over ℚ[t]. Fix any t∈K transcendental over ℚ. A_t is a finitely generated module over ℚ[t].

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Def_FermatCurveFieldChart.instance@124`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. import Definitions.Def_FermatCurveFieldBasic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.FieldDivision
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.IntegralClosure
import Mathlib.RingTheory.DedekindDomain.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Valuation.LocalSubring

/-!
# Affine charts of a curve field

For `t` in a curve field `K` transcendental over `ℚ`, the *chart ring* `A_t` is the integral
closure of `ℚ[t] = Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}` in `K`. It is the coordinate ring of the affine
open `{t ≠ ∞}` of the regular proper model of the curve: a Dedekind domain, finite over
`ℚ[t]`, of finite type over `ℚ`, with fraction field `K`. Every place of `K` containing `t` is
the localisation of `A_t` at a height-one prime (see `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place`).

The instances depending on the transcendence of `t` take the hypothesis in the form
`[Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)]`.

## Main definitions and results

* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing t`: the integral closure of `ℚ[t]` in `K`.
* instances `IsDedekindDomain (chartRing t)`, `IsFractionRing (chartRing t) K`,
  `Module.Finite (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) (chartRing t)`, `Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (chartRing t)`.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.chartRing_le`: `A_t` is contained in every integrally closed subring
  containing `ℚ` and `t` (e.g. valuation subrings).
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.inv_notMem_chartRing`: `t⁻¹ ∉ A_t`, i.e. `t` is not a unit of `A_t`.
-/

open Polynomial
open scoped IntermediateField IntermediateField.algebraAdjoinAdjoin

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]

/-- The chart ring `A_t`: the integral closure of `ℚ[t]` in `K`. -/
abbrev chartRing (t : K) : Subalgebra (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) K :=
  integralClosure (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) K

variable {t : K}

theorem mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :
    x ∈ chartRing t :=
  (chartRing t).algebraMap_mem ⟨x, hx⟩

variable (t) in
theorem self_mem_chartRing : t ∈ chartRing t :=
  mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin (Algebra.self_mem_adjoin_singleton ℚ t)

variable (t) in
theorem ratCast_mem_chartRing (q : ℚ) : (q : K) ∈ chartRing t :=
  mem_chartRing_of_mem_adjoin (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ q)

/-- The chart ring is contained in every integrally closed subring containing `ℚ` and `t`. -/
theorem chartRing_le {S : Subring K} [IsIntegrallyClosedIn S K] (hq : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ S)
    (ht : t ∈ S) : (chartRing t).toSubring ≤ S := by
  rw [Subring.integralClosure_le_iff]
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  change r ∈ S
  induction hr using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx => obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx; exact ht
  | algebraMap q => exact hq q
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact S.add_mem hx hy
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => exact S.mul_mem hx hy

/-- The chart ring is contained in every valuation subring containing `ℚ` and `t`. -/
theorem mem_of_mem_chartRing (V : ValuationSubring K) (hq : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ V)
    (ht : t ∈ V) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ chartRing t) : x ∈ V := by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn V.toSubring K := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn V K)
  exact chartRing_le (S := V.toSubring) hq ht hx

theorem isDedekindDomain_adjoin (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) :
    IsDedekindDomain (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) := by
  have e := Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental ℚ t ht
  have : IsPrincipalIdealRing (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
    IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective
  infer_instance

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : IsDedekindDomain (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
  isDedekindDomain_adjoin Fact.out

/-- The element `t` is not a unit of the chart ring `A_t`. -/
theorem inv_notMem_chartRing (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) : t⁻¹ ∉ chartRing t := by
  have := isDedekindDomain_adjoin ht
  intro h
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_transcendental ht
  let y : ℚ⟮t⟯ := ⟨t⁻¹, inv_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ t)⟩
  have hy : IsIntegral (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) y := by
    rw [← isIntegral_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) ℚ⟮t⟯ K)
      (algebraMap ℚ⟮t⟯ K).injective]
    exact h
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hy
  have hr' : (r : K) = t⁻¹ := congrArg Subtype.val hr
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℚ[X], aeval t p = r := by
    have : (r : K) ∈ (aeval (R := ℚ) t).range := by
      rw [← Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]; exact r.2
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := this
    exact ⟨p, hp⟩
  apply ht
  refine ⟨X * p - 1, fun h0 ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · 0) h0
    simp at this
  · simp [hp, hr', ht0]

variable [IsCurveField K]

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K :=
  finiteDimensional_adjoin Fact.out

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : IsFractionRing (chartRing t) K :=
  integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension ℚ⟮t⟯ K

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : IsDedekindDomain (chartRing t) :=
  IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) ℚ⟮t⟯ K (chartRing t)

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : Module.Finite (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) (chartRing t) :=
  IsIntegralClosure.finite (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) ℚ⟮t⟯ K (chartRing t)

instance [Fact (Transcendental ℚ t)] : Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (chartRing t) := by
  have : Algebra.FiniteType ℚ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) :=
    .adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton t)
  exact Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := Algebra.adjoin ℚ {t}) inferInstance inferInstance

> “Moreover, if $X$, $S$, and $T$ are defined over a number field $F$, then $\phi$ may be taken to be defined over $F$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, Theorem 2.5, printed pp.5–6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.infinityDivisorExists`

Let $N$ be a natural number and let $F$ be an intermediate field between $\mathbb Q$ and an algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q(T)$, with elements $u,v$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$, and $F$ is finite-dimensional of dimension $N$ over $\mathbb Q(u)$. A place $P$ means a valuation subring $O_P\ne F$ containing every rational number; write $k_P$ for its residue field. Assume every $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring and every $k_P$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. For $f\in F$, put $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$, where $V_P$ is the valuation on $F$ from the maximal ideal of $O_P$ and $\log_0$ is the integer-valued total logarithm called `WithZero.log` in the code, and put $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$. There exists a finite-support integer-valued function $H$ on the places such that $H(P)=\max(m_P(u),m_P(v))$ at every $P$. No hypothesis $N>3$ is imposed; $N=0$ admits no such model.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.infinityDivisorExists`

设 $N$ 为自然数，$F$ 为 $\mathbb Q$ 与 $\mathbb Q(T)$ 的一个代数闭包之间的中间域，且有元素 $u,v$ 满足：$u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越，$u^N+v^N=1$，$F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$，并且 $F$ 在 $\mathbb Q(u)$ 上有限维且维数为 $N$。这里的位 $P$ 是包含所有有理数且不等于 $F$ 的赋值子环 $O_P$，其剩余域记为 $k_P$。假设每个 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环，每个 $k_P$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上都有限维。对 $f\in F$，令 $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$，其中 $V_P$ 是由 $O_P$ 的极大理想给出的 $F$ 上的赋值，$\log_0$ 是代码中名为 `WithZero.log` 的取整数值的全定义对数；再令 $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$。存在这些位上具有有限支撑的整数值函数 $H$，使每个 $P$ 都满足 $H(P)=\max(m_P(u),m_P(v))$。没有假设 $N>3$；当 $N=0$ 时不存在这样的模型。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.infinityDivisorExists`

自然数 $N$ に対し、$F$ を $\mathbb Q$ と $\mathbb Q(T)$ の代数閉包の間の中間体とし、$u,v\in F$ が、$u$ は $\mathbb Q$ 上超越的、$u^N+v^N=1$、$F=\mathbb Q(u,v)$、および $F$ は $\mathbb Q(u)$ 上有限次元でその次元は $N$、という条件を満たすとする。ここで素点 $P$ とは、すべての有理数を含み $F$ と異なる付値部分環 $O_P$ をいい、その剰余体を $k_P$ と書く。すべての $O_P$ が離散付値環であり、すべての $k_P$ が $\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元であると仮定する。$f\in F$ に対し $o_P(f)=-\log_0(V_P(f))$ と置く。ただし $V_P$ は $O_P$ の極大イデアルによる $F$ 上の付値、$\log_0$ はコードで `WithZero.log` と呼ばれる整数値の全域的対数である。また $m_P(f)=\max(0,-o_P(f))$ と置く。すべての素点 $P$ で $H(P)=\max(m_P(u),m_P(v))$ を満たす有限台の整数値関数 $H$ が存在する。$N>3$ は仮定されていない。$N=0$ ではそのようなモデルは存在しない。

nodes.natural_language_statement:
> “Since $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ is infinite, it thus follows that there exists an $s_1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal{L})$ such that $s_1(t)\ne0$ for all $t\in T$. Thus, the linear series determined by the sections $s_0,s_1$ of $\mathcal{L}$ has no basepoints, hence determines a finite morphism $\psi:X\to\mathbb{P}^1_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}}$.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Noncritical Belyi Maps*, proof of Theorem 2.5, printed p. 6.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsCurveField`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. IsCurveField K means that there exists t∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(t).

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.transcendental_inv_iff`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For every t∈K, t⁻¹ is transcendental over ℚ if and only if t is.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.transcendental_inv`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For every t∈K transcendental over ℚ, t⁻¹ is also transcendental over ℚ.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ne_zero_of_transcendental`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. Every t∈K transcendental over ℚ is nonzero.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isTranscendenceBasis_of_finiteDimensional`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For every t∈K transcendental over ℚ, if K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(t), the one-element family with value t is a transcendence basis of K over ℚ.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.exists_transcendental`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. There exists an element of K transcendental over ℚ.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.trdeg_eq_one`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. The transcendence degree of K over ℚ is one.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isTranscendenceBasis`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. For every s∈K transcendental over ℚ, the one-element family with value s is a transcendence basis of K over ℚ.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isAlgebraic_adjoin`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. For every s∈K transcendental over ℚ, K is algebraic over ℚ(s).

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.exists_finset_adjoin_eq_top`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. There exists a finite subset S⊆K whose generated intermediate field over ℚ is all of K.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteDimensional_adjoin`

Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. For every s∈K transcendental over ℚ, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(s).

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model.isCurveField`

For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. The field K satisfies the following condition: there exists s∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(s).

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsCurveField`

设 K 为任意特征零域。曲线函数域条件指存在关于有理数域超越的 t∈K，使 K 在 ℚ(t) 上有限维。

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。K 中存在关于有理数域超越的元素。

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。对任意关于有理数域超越的 s∈K，唯一取值为 s 的单元素族是 K 在有理数域上的超越基。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isAlgebraic_adjoin`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。对任意关于有理数域超越的 s∈K，K 是 ℚ(s) 的代数扩张。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.exists_finset_adjoin_eq_top`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。存在有限子集 S⊆K，使其在有理数域上生成的中间域为整个 K。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteDimensional_adjoin`

设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。对任意关于有理数域超越的 s∈K，K 在 ℚ(s) 上有限维。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model.isCurveField`

对任意自然数 N 和任意给定模型 M，令 K=M.K 为有理数域与有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的一个固定代数闭包之间的中间域。模型给定 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。除子 A 指 K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数；除子不等式指每个处的系数不等式，若每个处 P 都满足 A(P)≥0，则称 A 有效。记 deg(P) 为剩余域 κ(P) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩，deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P)，其中剩余域次数先转为整数。自然数值有限秩在空间有限维时等于通常的向量空间维数。域 K 满足下述条件：存在关于有理数域超越的 s∈K，使 K 在 ℚ(s) 上有限维。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsCurveField`

K を任意の標数零の体とする。曲線関数体の条件とは、有理数体上超越的な t∈K が存在し、K が ℚ(t) 上有限次元となることである。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.transcendental_inv_iff`

K を任意の標数零の体とする。任意の t∈K に対し、t⁻¹ が有理数体上超越的であることと t がそうであることは同値である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.transcendental_inv`

K を任意の標数零の体とする。有理数体上超越的な任意の t∈K に対し、t⁻¹ も有理数体上超越的である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ne_zero_of_transcendental`

K を任意の標数零の体とする。有理数体上超越的な全ての t∈K は零でない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isTranscendenceBasis_of_finiteDimensional`

K を任意の標数零の体とする。有理数体上超越的な任意の t∈K に対し、K が ℚ(t) 上有限次元なら、値 t の一元族は K の有理数体上の超越基である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.exists_transcendental`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。K には有理数体上超越的な元が存在する。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.trdeg_eq_one`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。K の有理数体上の超越次数は一である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isTranscendenceBasis`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。有理数体上超越的な任意の s∈K に対し、値 s の一元族は K の有理数体上の超越基である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isAlgebraic_adjoin`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。有理数体上超越的な任意の s∈K に対し、K は ℚ(s) 上代数的である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.exists_finset_adjoin_eq_top`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。有限集合 S⊆K が存在し、S が有理数体上生成する中間体は K 全体となる。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteDimensional_adjoin`

K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。有理数体上超越的な任意の s∈K に対し、K は ℚ(s) 上有限次元である。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model.isCurveField`

任意の自然数 N と与えられた任意の模型 M に対し、K=M.K を有理数体と有理関数体 ℚ(X) の固定された代数閉包との間の中間体とする。模型は u,v∈K を与え、u は有理数体上超越的であり、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K は ℚ(u) 上有限次元かつ [K:ℚ(u)]=N を満たす。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。因子 A とは K の全ての素点上の有限台を持つ整数値関数である。因子の不等式は各係数の不等式を表し、全ての素点 P で A(P)≥0 なら A を有効という。deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P)、deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P) と書き、剰余体の次数は整数に型変換する。Module.finrank は自然数値の有限階数であり、空間が有限次元なら通常のベクトル空間の次元と一致する。体 K は次の条件を満たす。有理数体上超越的な s∈K が存在し、K は ℚ(s) 上有限次元である。

import Definitions.Def_FermatProperCarrier
import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Rat
import Mathlib.FieldTheory.IntermediateField.Adjoin.Algebra
import Mathlib.FieldTheory.IntermediateField.Adjoin.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.AlgebraicClosure
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.TranscendenceBasis

/-!
# Function fields of curves over number fields

A smooth proper geometrically connected curve over a number field is determined by its
function field. We represent such curves by their function fields: a field `K` of
characteristic `0` which is a finite extension of `ℚ(t)` for some `t ∈ K` transcendental
over `ℚ` (class `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsCurveField`). The `ℚ`-algebra structure on `K` is the
canonical one of a field of characteristic zero.

## Main definitions and results

* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsCurveField K`: `K` is finite over `ℚ⟮t⟯` for some transcendental `t`.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.exists_transcendental`: a curve field has a transcendental element.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.trdeg_eq_one`: its transcendence degree over `ℚ` is `1`.
* `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.isAlgebraic_adjoin`, `AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteDimensional_adjoin`:
  for *every* `s ∈ K` transcendental over `ℚ`, `K` is a finite extension of `ℚ⟮s⟯`.
-/

open scoped IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

/-- `K` is the function field of a curve over a number field: `K` is finite over `ℚ⟮t⟯` for
some `t ∈ K` transcendental over `ℚ`. -/
class IsCurveField (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] : Prop where
  exists_finite : ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t ∧ FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]

theorem transcendental_inv_iff {t : K} : Transcendental ℚ t⁻¹ ↔ Transcendental ℚ t :=
  not_congr IsAlgebraic.inv_iff

theorem transcendental_inv {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) : Transcendental ℚ t⁻¹ :=
  transcendental_inv_iff.mpr ht

theorem ne_zero_of_transcendental {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t) : t ≠ 0 := by
  rintro rfl
  exact ht isAlgebraic_zero

/-- If `K` is finite over `ℚ⟮t⟯`, then `{t}` is a transcendence basis of `K / ℚ`. -/
theorem isTranscendenceBasis_of_finiteDimensional {t : K} (ht : Transcendental ℚ t)
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K] : IsTranscendenceBasis ℚ (fun _ : Unit ↦ t) := by
  refine (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.mpr ht).isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic.mpr ?_
  rw [Set.range_const, ← IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff_top]
  infer_instance

variable [IsCurveField K]

variable (K) in
/-- A curve field contains an element transcendental over `ℚ`. -/
theorem exists_transcendental : ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t :=
  let ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := IsCurveField.exists_finite (K := K); ⟨t, ht⟩

variable (K) in
/-- A curve field has transcendence degree one over `ℚ`. -/
theorem trdeg_eq_one : Algebra.trdeg ℚ K = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := IsCurveField.exists_finite (K := K)
  have := (isTranscendenceBasis_of_finiteDimensional ht).lift_cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
  simpa using this.symm

/-- Every transcendental element of a curve field is a transcendence basis. -/
theorem isTranscendenceBasis {s : K} (hs : Transcendental ℚ s) :
    IsTranscendenceBasis ℚ (fun _ : Unit ↦ s) :=
  (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.mpr hs).isTranscendenceBasis_of_lift_trdeg_le_of_finite
    (by rw [trdeg_eq_one K]; simp)

/-- A curve field is algebraic over `ℚ⟮s⟯` for every transcendental `s`. -/
theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin {s : K} (hs : Transcendental ℚ s) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ⟮s⟯ K := by
  have := (isTranscendenceBasis hs).isAlgebraic_field
  rwa [Set.range_const] at this

variable (K) in
/-- A curve field is finitely generated as a field over `ℚ`. -/
theorem exists_finset_adjoin_eq_top :
    ∃ S : Finset K, IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (S : Set K) = ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := IsCurveField.exists_finite (K := K)
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := IntermediateField.fg_top (F := ℚ⟮t⟯) (E := K)
  classical
  refine ⟨insert t S, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (IntermediateField.restrictScalars ℚ) hS
  have h2 := IntermediateField.adjoin_adjoin_left ℚ (S := {t}) (S : Set K)
  rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_top] at this
  rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.insert_eq, ← h2]
  exact this

/-- A curve field is a finite extension of `ℚ⟮s⟯` for every transcendental `s`. -/
theorem finiteDimensional_adjoin {s : K} (hs : Transcendental ℚ s) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮s⟯ K := by
  have := isAlgebraic_adjoin hs
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_finset_adjoin_eq_top K
  have htop : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ⟮s⟯ (S : Set K) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff (K := ℚ), eq_top_iff, ← hS,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _
  have := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin (K := ℚ⟮s⟯) (S := (S : Set K))
    (fun x _ ↦ (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x).isIntegral)
  rw [htop] at this
  exact IntermediateField.topEquiv.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional


/-- The source class has one field, already present in the fixed model. -/
theorem Model.isCurveField {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) : IsCurveField M.K :=
  ⟨⟨M.u, M.transcendental_u, M.finite_u⟩⟩

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper
